column1: # context surface — the declared documents that carry agent context, one row each.
#   edit             a compression pass may land here (the project's §2 safe write-path)
#   law              Owner-ratified text; only the Owner edits it
#   protected        §2 evidence / hash-pinned; never edited in place
#   cite-sensitive   its line numbers are cited elsewhere (citecheck must follow a change)
#   project-gated    the project's own doc gate owns this ceiling (DSH verify-doc-budgets)
# ceiling policy (declared, then corrected twice by measurement on 2026-09-21)
#   1. First declaration set every edit-zone ceiling to a policy target 20% below baseline.
#      Measured wrong: three of the five documents compressed had no duplicate home left to
#      remove, so the target demanded deleting content — §3.4 forbids that.
#   2. Ceilings are therefore derived from the ACHIEVED count: achieved_words x 1.05, rounded
#      up to the nearest 10 (the DSH headroom convention). A ceiling ratchets DOWN only;
#      raising one requires a written justification in the change.
#   3. CONCURRENT WRITER (2026-09-21 07:04-07:05). Another session rewrote colony-kernel,
#      dyno-pony, crew-research-council and knowledge-factory entry documents in one batch,
#      committed colony-kernel and dyno-pony, and removed crew-research-council/PROTECTED.md
#      (untracked, and in no git history). The revisions this session measured for those four
#      projects no longer exist, so their ceilings are re-derived from the 07:05 disk state.
#      This session did NOT re-apply its own superseded edits. See the receipt §10.
#   Rows still at a policy target are documents with a known duplicate home that no pass has
#   reached — the gate stays red for them by design, with a numeric finish line.
# Bindings added 2026-09-21 (deep-dive round): CONSTITUTION.md binds to the one-file
# $HOME repository created for exactly this row; anatomy-lab/README.md + PROTECTED.md
# bind to the lab repository initialized the same round (its frozen SOULs and
# declarations were unversioned evidence — the crew-loss failure class).
